notes.title: Bone To Gather 1.3 Version Update
notes.notes:
We added extra languages for more people to enjoy our game. I am afraid but there could be some wrong translations since we do not have native speakers in our team. If you have any issue to report regarding translation, please let us know via Discord! Thank your understanding!


Major Updates
- Now support Simplified Chinese
- Now support Traditional Chinese

notes.title: Bone To Gather 1.2 Version Update
notes.notes:
We’ve been carefully reviewing your feedback.
Thankfully, it’s not an overwhelming amount to keep up with… yet!

For this patch, we aim to lower the overall difficulty.
Additionally, our goal is to enable more diverse synergy combinations for your gameplay experience.

When paired with the previous relic patch, we believe other synergies will also feel powerful enough.

Feedback that hasn’t been addressed this time is either facing technical challenges (!) or is under internal review.
We’ll strive to implement them as soon as possible. Thank you for your support!

Major UpdatesMonster Stat Adjustments    Regular monsters' HP decreased by 30%.    Boss monsters' HP decreased by 33%.    Small rats' movement speed decreased by 30%.    Regular monsters now have longer attack cooldowns.Comment: It seems the game was too difficult. Currently, the Demon King clear rate is below 30%!

Monster Pattern Changes    Stage 6 Boss (Name: Moose)                    Moose’s charge attack now has a 1-second delay.            Comment: The sudden close-range charge was overly threatening. Time to pause that charge!

Synergy Adjustments    The Popstar’s spotlight now tracks enemies.Comment: Performing just got easier! Although it may not move exactly the way you’d like.

Unit Changes    The attack power of Cook Skeletons has been decreased by 20%.Comment: This aligns with the above updates. It’s a good opportunity to explore other synergies now.

System Changes    Mouse Multi-Click Prevention                    A 0.1-second cooldown is now applied after a mouse click.            Comment: You won’t notice it during normal clicking. Rapid clicking, however, just got a bit harder.
    Gold Added for Skipping Rewards                    Skipping a reward now grants 2 gold.            Comment: Try not to skip relic rewards!
    Reduced Retry Floors                    Retry and restart floors have been adjusted from 7 → 6.            Comment: Take more shots at Moose!

Minor Changes    The Popstar's spotlight now disappears immediately after clearing a stage.

notes.title: Hotfix 241220
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where monsters could escape through walls.

-Corrected some inaccurate English text in relic and synergy descriptions.

-Fixed a bug where the shop did not update when inventory changes were made during the shop phase.

-Fixed an issue where the Tundra effect was not applied to the Rat Den.

-Battle-related sound effects now turn off when the stage is cleared.

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.notes:
We feel immensely grateful for all the love and support from players.

Despite being our first patch, it’s packed with significant changes that we believe you’ll gradually adapt to as you play.

P.S. Many have asked why this game is free. It's not. This is a paid game—we’re selling it for a return of one review. 

(Positive reviews mean the world to us! Please consider leaving one. Thank you!)

Major Updates

Collection Update

- A new feature, Skeleton Collection, has been added.
- Skeletons that defeat the Demon King will now be added to the collection, unlocking their backstory.
- One new related achievement has been added.

Relics Added and Balance Adjustments

- All relic prices have been reduced to 30G.
- 12 new relics have been added.

Relic Adjustments

Jack
    - Number of Skeletons provided: 2 → 1

Cheerful Hood
    - Attack power increase: 10% → 6%

Aztec Gold
    - Provided Skeleton Level: 3-star → 2-star
    - Related bug fixed (Skeleton were refilling upon purchase of a relic when this relic was active).

Flaming Motorcycle
    - Attack power increase: 50% → 30%

Lich’s Crown
    - Attack power increase: 150% → 90%

Rattling Bow
    - Attack power increase: 30% → 20%

Dragon’s Claw
    - Attack power increase: 6% → 4%

White Guitar
    - Attack power increase: 75% → 50%

Bombhead’s Violin
    - Attack power increase: 6% → 4%

Big Scythe
    - Attack power increase: 30% → 20%

New Relics Added

- Doctor’s Mask
- Large Lizard Egg
- Magic Wand
- Swaggy Skateboard
- Energy Drink
- Eternal Vow
- Bakers Hat
- Cool Score
- Star of My Heart
- Red Balloon
- Heavy Piggy
- Protective Shield

Event Adjustments

- Event probabilities adjusted due to relic value changes.
- Gold required by Suspicious Merchant: 10 → 8

Major System Updates

Maximum Gold Limit
    - No limit → 100G
    Comment: Mice are good source of money. Use it wisely and spend it often.
    
Stage Balance Adjustments
    - Overall difficulty of stages 2 and 3 has been increased.
    - Final boss difficulty increased.
    Comment: A strong team should still make it manageable, though.
    
Beholder Boss Pattern Adjustments
    - 
    Comment: You might want to focus a bit more.
    
Reduced Skeletons hitbox
    - Reduced by 10%.
    Comment: Dodging should feel a bit more thrilling now.
    

Synergy Changes

Magic Academy
    - Projectile damage from summoned creatures is now correctly increased.

Popstar
    - Spotlight size now increases more intuitively.
    - Popstar Synergy properly turn on when bonus Popstar synergy from events or relics is added.

Minor Changes and Bug Fixes

-The issue where the game stage is not loaded for certain countries is now fixed.  
    Comment: We apologize for causing inconvenience.
    
- Final boss stage BGM updated.

-Added a data deletion button in settings.
Comment: Only use this if you encounter critical game-breaking bugs!

UI Updates:
    - Title screen button text size adjusted.
    - “Back” button added to the guide in the title screen.
    - Guide updated to clarify Attack Damage descriptions.
    - Skeleton card UI updated.
    - Warning notification UI added.

Fixed David’s skill bugs:
    - Tundra and Slum synergies now apply to David’s bombs.
